general_faqs.question: What is the Swarm Agentic Platform?
general_faqs.answer: Swarm is an enterprise-grade multi-agent platform designed to build, deploy, orchestrate, and optimize autonomous AI workflows that run inside secure sandboxed environments.

general_faqs.question: How do I deploy a Swarm Agent?
general_faqs.answer: You can deploy agents using the Swarm CLI (`swarm deploy <agent-name>`), via the Visual Workflow Designer in the web dashboard, or using our Git-integrated auto-deployment triggers.

general_faqs.question: Do I need coding experience to use Swarm?
general_faqs.answer: No. Non-technical users can construct complex workflows using the drag-and-drop Visual Workflow Designer, while developers can write customized agent logic in Python, Javascript, or Go.

general_faqs.question: Where is my data stored?
general_faqs.answer: By default, customer metadata is stored in our secure Cloud environment. Enterprise customers can opt for on-premise deployments or choose data residency regions (US, EU, Singapore) so that execution logs never leave their network.
